caption: The drawing depicts a clear glass bottle with a decorative stopper, rendered in shades of gray, black, and white, giving it a monochrome appearance. The bottle has a rounded body with vertical ribbed patterns on its lower section, and bulbous, rounded contours on the upper section leading to a narrow neck. The neck features three pronounced horizontal rings before the top. The stopper is circular and fluted, resembling a sunburst or rosette design. In the lower left corner of the composition, there is an inset drawing labeled "END VIEW OF STOPPER," showing a different perspective of the stopper, which appears elongated and textured with a leaf-like pattern. The drawing is framed by two rectangular outlines, one for the main view and a smaller one for the inset. The artist's name, Francis Law Durand, is noted at the lower right.
title: Decanter
